title: Executive Overview
subtitle: Store performance for the selected period

compare.label: Compare
compare.thinBaselineHint: The previous period holds limited data, so this percentage change overstates the movement.

definition.netSales: Total sales after discounts and returns, per the approved reporting rules.
definition.grossProfit: Net sales minus cost of goods sold.
definition.grossMargin: Gross profit as a share of net sales.
definition.orders: Orders recognised as sales in the period.
definition.averageOrderValue: Net sales divided by order count.
definition.discountRate: Discounts as a share of gross sales.
definition.returns: Refunded value for returns processed in the period.
definition.returnRate: Returns as a share of gross sales.
definition.newCustomers: Customers registered for the first time in the period.
definition.inventoryValue: Current on-hand stock valued at cost.
definition.purchaseSpend: What was owed to suppliers on purchases recognised in this period. Drafts, cancellations and reversals are excluded.
definition.purchaseOrders: Number of recognised purchase orders in the period.
definition.purchaseUnits: Units received across all purchase lines in the period.
definition.averagePurchaseValue: Purchase spend divided by the number of purchase orders.
definition.averageUnitCost: Total line value divided by total units. Weighted, so one odd single-unit line cannot distort it.
definition.activeSuppliers: Suppliers with at least one recognised purchase in the period.
definition.purchasedProducts: Distinct products appearing on purchase lines in the period.
definition.unpaidPurchaseValue: Total minus paid, on purchases recognised in this period only. This is not the supplier ledger balance.
definition.supplierReturnUnits: Units raised to suppliers in the period. These come from customer returns, so they are not drawn from the units purchased here.
definition.totalCustomers: Customer records on file for this tenant.
definition.activeCustomers: Customers who placed at least one order in the period.
definition.returningCustomers: Active customers who have bought more than once in total.
definition.repeatPurchaseRate: Repeat customers as a share of active customers.
definition.customerOrders: Orders in the period that are attached to a customer record.
definition.customerRevenue: Net sales from orders attached to a customer record. Walk-in sales are excluded.
definition.averageCustomerValue: Customer revenue divided by active customers.
definition.ordersPerCustomer: Customer orders divided by active customers.
definition.lapsedCustomers: Customers who have stopped: at risk plus dormant.
definition.registeredInWindow: Customer records created in the period, whether or not they ordered.
definition.sellerNetSales: Net sales over the period, on the same canonical basis as the Executive Overview. Includes orders with no seller.
definition.sellerUnits: Units sold, net of returned quantity.
definition.activeSellers: Distinct sellers named on an order in the period.
definition.activeCashiers: Distinct users who rang up an order. This is not the same question as who sold it.
definition.activeChannels: Distinct sales channels used in the period.
definition.salesPerSeller: Attributed net sales divided by the number of active sellers. Unattributed sales are excluded from the numerator.
definition.attributionCoverage: Share of orders in the period that carry a seller. Below 20% the per-person breakdown is withheld.
definition.unattributedNetSales: Net sales on orders that carry no seller. Never shared out across the named sellers.

formula.grossProfit: Net sales − cost of goods sold
formula.purchasedProducts: COUNT(DISTINCT product on a purchase line)
formula.activeCustomers: COUNT(DISTINCT customer with an order in the period)
formula.returningCustomers: COUNT(active customers with more than one lifetime order)
formula.customerRevenue: SUM(order revenue) where customer is set
formula.unattributedNetSales: SUM(net sales) WHERE seller IS NULL

coverage.label: Cost coverage
coverage.explain: Share of sold units with a recorded cost. The lower it is, the less reliable profit becomes.
coverage.unavailableReason: Cost coverage is below 50%, so no trustworthy profit figure can be shown.

warnings.title: Data notes
warnings.COGS_COVERAGE_LOW: Some sold units have no recorded cost, so profit may be overstated.
warnings.COGS_COVERAGE_CRITICAL: Cost data is insufficient to show a trustworthy profit.
warnings.INVENTORY_COST_COVERAGE_LOW: Some stock items have no recorded cost, so inventory value is understated.
warnings.COMPARISON_BASE_ZERO: The comparison period has no data, so percentage change cannot be calculated.
warnings.EXCHANGE_COGS_UNREVERSED: Exchange orders do not reverse the original order's cost, so cost may be double-counted.
warnings.EXCHANGE_CREDIT_RETAINED: Net sales include {{creditRetained}} of exchange credit the customer has not used.
warnings.ORPHAN_RETURN_ITEMS: Some return lines are not linked to a sold line and cannot be attributed to products.
warnings.STOCK_SOURCE_DIVERGENCE: The legacy product stock figure disagrees with live variant stock.
warnings.UNCATEGORISED_SALES_HIGH: A large share of sales has no category assigned.
warnings.RETURNS_FALLBACK_USED: Return tables could not be read, so returns were not deducted.
warnings.NAN_VALUES_IGNORED: Corrupt numeric values were ignored in the calculation.
warnings.FILTERED_EXCLUDES_RETURNS: With a product filter applied, figures come straight from order lines and returns are not deducted, because a return is not tied to a specific product.
warnings.BREAKDOWN_EXCLUDES_RETURNS: Breakdown values are before returns that cannot be attributed to a product.
warnings.PRODUCT_LIST_TRUNCATED: There are more products than the display limit, so only the highest-selling ones are shown.
warnings.SIZE_SCOPE_REQUIRED: Choose a single product type to see size analysis, because size ranges differ between types.
warnings.SIZE_SCOPE_APPLIED: Colour-only and one-size products are excluded from size analysis.
warnings.SIZES_SOLD_OUT: Some sizes sold during the period and now have no stock.
warnings.UNKNOWN_MOVEMENT_TYPE: Inventory movement types are present that the system does not define; they are excluded from every calculation rather than classified by guess.
warnings.VELOCITY_UNKNOWN_AGE: Some products have no receipt history, so their movement class (fast/slow/stagnant) cannot be determined.
warnings.VELOCITY_UNCLASSIFIED: Some products fall between the classification thresholds and are shown without a movement class.
warnings.DIMENSION_NOT_USABLE: This breakdown has no meaningful split for the data in this period.
warnings.MISSING_SIZES: Some sizes exist as variants but currently have no stock.
warnings.PURCHASE_LINE_HEADER_DELTA: Purchase lines do not add up to the purchase totals. Spend figures use the totals; every per-product and per-supplier figure uses the lines, so the two will not match.
warnings.SUPPLIER_RETURN_COHORT_MISMATCH: Supplier returns are raised from customer returns, so the return rate is not a share of the units purchased in this period. Read it as a signal.
warnings.PRICE_TREND_NEEDS_COMPARISON: Choose a comparison period to see how each purchase price moved.
warnings.CUSTOMER_TOTALS_DIVERGENCE: The stored customer total does not match the canonical order total. Every figure here uses the canonical total; the stored column needs rebuilding.
warnings.WALK_IN_ORDERS_EXCLUDED: Orders with no customer record are excluded from this page, because they cannot be attributed to a customer.
warnings.CUSTOMER_SEGMENT_UNCLASSIFIED: Customer segmentation produced a class the contract does not describe.
warnings.CUSTOMER_NAMES_RESTRICTED: Customer names are hidden because this account does not hold the customers permission. Every figure is unaffected.
warnings.SELLER_ATTRIBUTION_UNAVAILABLE: No column on the order carries a usable seller, so sales cannot be attributed to a person in this period. The channel and cashier views are unaffected.
warnings.SELLER_ATTRIBUTION_TOO_THIN: Too few orders carry a seller for a per-person breakdown to mean anything, so it is not shown.
warnings.SELLER_ATTRIBUTION_PARTIAL: Not every order carries a seller. The per-person figures cover only the ones that do, and the remainder is shown as its own row.
warnings.SELLER_UNATTRIBUTED_ORDERS: Some orders carry no seller. They are shown as their own row and are never shared out across the named sellers.
warnings.ACCOUNTING_COMPARISON_UNAVAILABLE: The accounting profit and loss could not be read, so the deliberate differences could not be measured. The Reporting Center's own consistency checks are unaffected.
warnings.RECONCILIATION_FAILED: Two screens that answer the same question returned different numbers. Every figure derived from the failing check is suspect until it is resolved.

legacy.title: This is the legacy report
legacy.intro: These figures are kept for continuity, but a data audit confirmed they are computed differently from the Reporting Center. Where the two disagree, the Reporting Center is the corrected one.

defect.scope: Revenue here includes cancelled, draft, soft-deleted and personal orders, which the Reporting Center excludes.
defect.profit: Gross profit cannot be computed on this page, because order lines carry no cost column. It is shown as unavailable rather than as a number equal to revenue.
defect.errors: A failed query on this page returns zero rather than an error, so a zero here may mean a failure.
defect.stock: Inventory value here reads a stock column that nothing writes to, so it can disagree with the real stock on hand.
defect.dates: Date-filtered product figures on this page silently return nothing, because products carries no created date.
